page.layout: One page of running text in one column; left margin holds one marginal note with a reference mark ("Cap.1.") beside the paragraph beginning "Etenim ipse Galenus"; the printed bullet marks (») in the left margin are list markers, not notes. Running head at top; page number at top left; a signature-like word "Si" at the foot right, which is a catchword.

main_text.l: ad suum dogma confirmandum satis est ua
lida. Post hanc, ad alia, quam a Galeno Fer-
nelius se defumpsisse ait, nobis progredien
dum est. Haec mihi (inquit Brutus Eudoxi
argumenta probans) cum superioribus sa-
tis videntur cohaerere, si modo tu his eum
Galeni locum concilies, qui in unaquaque
similari parte ait substantias tres haberi, scilicet so-
lidam, carnosam
et spirituosam: ex quibus
ait virium substantiam compleri. Eudoxus
id quidem facile. Nam solida atque carnosa
eam, quam dixi partis similaris materiam
constituunt. Spirituosa, in qua calor est in-
situs ad formam referetur ac pertinet. Haec
Fernelius, quibus (pace tanti viri dixerim)
Galeni mentem, sensaque praue detorquet.
Etenim ipse Galenus undecimo Methodi
medendi, non partem similarem ait, sed na-
turam verbis perspicuis exprimit. Natura
(inquit) ex tribus his partibus constat, ex
spiritus substantia, ex earum, quae verae di-
cuntur solidae, substantia (quas alibi ex fe-
mine genitali conditas esse monstrauimus)
& tertia ab his carnosa, quae cuiq; particulae
est sua. His Galenus, virium essentia in spi-
ritus, carnis & solidarum partium iusta quan-
titate & qualitate consistere planum facit.

page.notes: Printed text is a mix of roman and italic; the scan is faded and the Latin of the middle lines was read with some uncertainty, so doubtful words are unmarked here only where the scan was clear. Probable printing errors left as printed: "ex tribus his partibus", "ex earum". The reference mark "1" in the text is not visible at its place in the body; the note "Cap.1." was printed in the left margin beside the paragraph. The letter-by-letter reading of the middle lines (from "Haec mihi" to "compleri") and of the lines "Spiritu osa" and "ex earum" is partly conjectural and should be checked against the scan. Bullet markers (») in the left margin are not text and are omitted. The final line "Si" is a catchword at the foot right.
